exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  B were        11  A is
   2  C Did         12  C made
   3  A couldn't    13  B weren't
   4  C go          14  A will
   5  A –           15  C didn't
   6  B graduated   16  B was
   7  C between     17  A have
   8  B The         18  A on
   9  B Was         19  C last
  10  C because     20  B didn't


MAVZULAR BO'YIChA GURUHLASh:

  PAST SIMPLE — 'BE' (Unit 9) —
     1, 9, 13, 16
  PAST SIMPLE — BOShQA FE'LLAR (Unit 10) —
     2, 4, 6, 12, 15, 17, 20
  'COULD/COULDN'T' (Unit 9) — 3
  ARTIKL (Unit 10) — 5, 8
  PREDLOG (Unit 3, 9) — 7, 18
  BOG'LOVChI (Unit 10) — 10
  'THERE IS/ARE' (Unit 3) — 11
  'WILL' (Unit 10) — 14
  VAQT KO'RSATKIChI (Unit 10) — 19


⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA — 'DID' DAN KEYIN
ASOSIY ShAKL:

   2  'DID you SEE Lindsay yesterday?'
   4  'Where did they GO at Christmas?'
  15  'I DIDN'T HAVE a motorcycle.'
  17  'Did you HAVE a pet?'
  20  'I DIDN'T GO to school.'

  ⚠ Beshta bandda ham ASOSIY shakl:
     'did you SEE'  ✓  'did you SAW'  ✗
     'did they GO'  ✓  'did they WENT' ✗
     'didn't HAVE'  ✓  'didn't HAD'   ✗

  TASDIQDA esa 2-shakl:
   6  'He GRADUATED in 1998.'
  12  'My father MADE a dinner.'


⚠ 'BE' FE'LI 'DID' TALAB QILMAYDI:

   1  'Where WERE you born?'
      ('Where DID you be born?' — XATO!)
   9  'WAS Helen at the park?'
  13  'There WEREN'T any CDs.'
  16  'Charles Dickens WAS born.'

  ⚠ 'be' fe'lining o'zi savol va inkor
  yasaydi.


──── HAR BAND BO'YIChA ────

 1  'Where WERE you born?'
    'you' → WERE.
    ⚠ 'be born' — majhul nisbat.

 2  'DID you see Lindsay yesterday?'
    'yesterday' → Past Simple savoli.

 3  'Emily COULDN'T read when she was two,
     but she CAN read now.'
    ⚠ KALIT: ikkinchi qism 'she CAN read
    NOW' — hozir o'qiy oladi.
    Demak ilgari O'QIY OLMAGAN → COULDN'T.
    ('could' — mantiqan zid;
     'can't' — hozirgi zamon.)

 4  'Where did they GO at Christmas?'
    'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl.

 5  'He likes playing – BASKETBALL.'
    ⚠ SPORT bilan ARTIKL YO'Q!
       play football / basketball / tennis

    ⚠ CholG'U ASBOBI bilan 'THE':
       play THE guitar / THE piano

    (Workbook 1-nazorat testi, 2-mashq,
     9-band: 'I like playing THE guitar.')

 6  'He GRADUATED from university in 1998.'
    '1998' — aniq o'tmish → 2-shakl.
    ⚠ 'graduate FROM' — predlog 'from'.

 7  'The cinema is BETWEEN the café AND
     the post office.'
    ⚠ KALIT: 'AND' bor → ikki narsa
    ORASIDA → BETWEEN.

 8  'THE Amazon is in Brazil.'
    ⚠ DARYOLAR oldida DOIM 'THE'.
    (5-nazorat testi, Workbook 2-mashq,
     10-band ham shu edi!)

 9  'WAS Helen at the park on Sunday?'
    'Helen' — birlik → WAS.
    ⚠ 'Did Helen be...' — XATO.

10  'She went to the dentist BECAUSE she
     had toothache.'
    SABAB → BECAUSE.
    ('but' — qarama-qarshilik;
     'and' — qo'shish.)

11  'There IS a new museum.'
    'a museum' — BIRLIK → IS.
    ⚠ Bu HOZIRGI zamon (o'tmish emas!).

12  'My father MADE a delicious dinner
     LAST NIGHT.'
    'last night' → 2-shakl.
    make → MADE → made.

13  'There WEREN'T any CDs 100 years AGO.'
    'CDs' — KO'PLIK, o'tmish, inkor →
    WEREN'T.
    ⚠ Inkorda 'ANY'.
    ⚠ 'hadn't' — 'there' bilan
    ishlatilmaydi.

14  'I WILL finish it TOMORROW.'
    'tomorrow' → KELAJAK → WILL.

15  'I DIDN'T have a motorcycle when I was
     ten.'
    'when I WAS ten' — o'tmish → DIDN'T.
    ⚠ 'wasn't have' — XATO (ikki fe'l).
    ⚠ 'won't' — kelajak.

16  'Charles Dickens WAS born in
     Portsmouth.'
    Bir odam → WAS.
    ⚠ 'be born' — majhul nisbat
    ('had born' XATO).

17  'DID you HAVE a pet when you were
     young?'
    'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl → HAVE.

18  'My house is ON the corner of Pine
     Road AND Maple Avenue.'
    ⚠ 'ON the corner of X and Y' — turg'un
    birikma.
    ⚠ 7-band bilan solishtiring: u yerda
    'BETWEEN' (ikki bino orasida), bu
    yerda 'ON the corner' (burchakda).

19  'He went to the cinema LAST Saturday.'
    ⚠ 'LAST' otdan OLDIN;
      'AGO' o'lchovdan KEYIN
      ('two days ago').
    'yesterday Saturday' — mantiqsiz.

20  'I DIDN'T go to school yesterday
     because I was ill.'
    'yesterday' → Past Simple inkor.


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to graduate = bitirmoq (o'quv yurtini)
  a university = universitet
  a café      = kafe
  a post office = pochta bo'limi
  a dentist   = tish shifokori
  toothache   = tish og'rig'i
  a museum    = muzey
  delicious   = mazali
  a motorcycle = mototsikl
  a pet       = uy hayvoni
  ill         = kasal
  an avenue   = keng ko'cha

⚠ KITOBDA BOSMA XATO:

  8-bandda 'The Amazon is in Brazil..' —
  gap oxirida IKKI NUQTA bosilgan.

  ⚠ To'g'risi — bitta nuqta.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the missing words.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'sh joylarni tushib qolgan so'zlar bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

   1  was born
   2  did
   3  Did you have
   4  last time
   5  were
   6  didn't have
   7  Who was
   8  weren't
   9  What was
  10  same
  11  can you
  12  Who
  13  couldn't
  14  had
  15  he didn't
  16  How many
  17  corner of
  18  on
  19  What kind
  20  couldn't

⚠ 3, 7, 9, 12, 16, 19-bandlar GAP BOShIDA
turadi → kitobda BOSh HARF bilan.


──── PAST SIMPLE: 'TO BE' ────

 5  'WHERE WERE you yesterday? — At home.'
    'you' → WERE.

 8  'There were guest houses but there
     WEREN'T any hotels then.'
    ko'plik inkor → WEREN'T.

 9  'WHAT WAS the weather like in Madrid?
     — It WAS hot.'
    'the weather' — birlik → WAS.

  ⚠ JADVAL:
     I / he / she / it → WAS / WASN'T
     you / we / they   → WERE / WEREN'T


──── PAST SIMPLE: BOShQA FE'LLAR ────

 2  'What DID you have for lunch YESTERDAY?'
 3  'DID YOU HAVE a dog when you were six?
     — No, I didn't.'
 6  'They had bicycles but they DIDN'T HAVE
     cars then.'
14  'They HAD two sons, but they didn't have
     any daughters.'
15  'Did he travel by plane? — No, HE
     DIDN'T.'

  ⚠ ENG MUHIM QOIDA:
     'DID' va 'DIDN'T' dan keyin ASOSIY
     ShAKL!

        'They DIDN'T HAVE cars.'   ✓
        'They didn't HAD cars.'    ✗
        'What DID you HAVE?'       ✓
        'What did you HAD?'        ✗

     Lekin tasdiqda 2-shakl:
        'They HAD two sons.'  ✓

  ⚠ 14-BAND — BIR GAPDA IKKALASI:
     'They HAD two sons, but they DIDN'T
      HAVE any daughters.'
     tasdiq → HAD (2-shakl);
     inkor → DIDN'T HAVE (asosiy shakl).


──── 'COULD' / 'COULDN'T' ────

13  'He COULD talk when he was one, but he
     COULDN'T walk.'
20  'James COULDN'T read until he was
     seven.'

  ⚠ 'could' — 'can' ning O'TMISh shakli.
  Keyin ASOSIY shakl:
     'he couldn't WALK'  ✓
     'he couldn't WALKED' ✗


──── SAVOL SO'ZLARI ────

 7  'WHO WAS Elvis Presley? — An American
     singer.'
    Javob ODAM haqida → WHO.

12  'WHO did you go out with? — James.'
    Javob ODAM ismi → WHO.
    ⚠ Predlog 'with' GAP OXIRIDA qoladi.

16  'HOW MANY operas did he write? —
     Forty.'
    'operas' — sanaladigan ko'plik →
    HOW MANY.

19  'WHAT KIND of music does the band play?
     — Rock.'
    ⚠ 'What SORT of' / 'What TYPE of' ham
    to'g'ri.


──── YO'NALISh KO'RSATISh (Unit 10) ────

11  'Excuse me, CAN YOU tell me the way to
     the bank?'
    ⚠ 'COULD you ...?' ham to'g'ri
    (muloyimroq).
    'tell somebody THE WAY TO ...' —
    turg'un ibora.

17  'The supermarket is on the CORNER OF
     Oak Street and Hill Street.'
    'on the corner of X and Y' = X va Y
    ko'chalarining burchagida.

18  'The bank is ON your right.'
    ⚠ 'ON your right/left' — predlog 'on'.


──── LUG'AT ────

 1  'He WAS BORN in 1938 and DIED in 1987.'
    ⚠ 'be born' — majhul nisbat!
       'He WAS BORN.'    ✓
       'He born.'        ✗
       'He was borned.'  ✗

    Lekin 'die' — oddiy fe'l:
       'He DIED in 1987.'  ✓

 4  'When was the LAST TIME you visited your
     parents?'
    'the last time' = oxirgi marta.

10  'My town isn't the SAME as it was thirty
     years ago.'
    ⚠ 'the SAME AS' — turg'un birikma.
       'the same AS'    ✓
       'the same LIKE'  ✗


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to be born  = tug'ilmoq
  to die      = vafot etmoq
  a bicycle   = velosiped
  a guest house = mehmon uyi
  the same as = ... bilan bir xil
  the way to  = ... ga yo'l
  an opera    = opera
  a supermarket = supermarket
  a corner    = burchak
  a band      = musiqiy guruh
  rock        = rok (musiqa)
  a daughter  = qiz (farzand)

exercises.explanationUz:
BARCHA JAVOBLAR:
   1  C turning (yoki B turn)
   2  C completed
   3  B at
   4  A wasn't
   5  C those
   6  A in front of
   7  A until
   8  B running
   9  C coast
  10  B The


⚠ 1-BAND — IKKI VARIANT MUMKIN:

  'Take the first TURNING on your left.'
     — Britaniya inglizchasida yo'nalish
       ko'rsatishning ODATIY shakli.

  'Take the first TURN on your left.'
     — bu ham grammatik jihatdan to'g'ri.

  'corner' — bu qurilmada IShLATILMAYDI
     ('take the first corner' — mavjud
      emas).

  Enterprise — BRITANIYA kitobi, shuning
  uchun 'turning' ko'zda tutilgan.


QOLGANLARI NEGA:

 2  'Diana COMPLETED her education in
     Switzerland.'
    ⚠ 'complete one's education' = ta'limni
    TUGATMOQ.
    'studied her education' — takror
       ('study' o'zi o'qish demakdir).
    'cared her education' — mantiqsiz
       ('care ABOUT' bo'lardi).

 3  'She wasn't AT home.'
    ⚠ 'AT home' — turg'un ibora, ARTIKLSIZ.
    'in home' / 'of home' — XATO.

 4  'He WASN'T tired, SO he went to the
     cinema.'
    MANTIQ: 'so' natijani bildiradi.
    Charchamagan → kinoga bordi ✓
    Charchagan → kinoga bordi ✗ (uyga
       borardi)

 5  'There wasn't an airport in THOSE days.'
    ⚠ 'IN THOSE DAYS' = o'sha kunlarda
    (turg'un ibora, O'TMISh haqida).
    'these days' = hozirgi kunlarda
       (HOZIR haqida) — 'wasn't' ga zid!
    'that days' — grammatik XATO
       ('that day' birlik).

 6  'There is a nice garden IN FRONT OF her
     house.'
    'in front of' = oldida, ro'parasida.
    'on her house' — uy USTIDA (mantiqsiz).
    'in her house' — uy IChIDA (bog' uy
       ichida bo'lmaydi).

 7  'She couldn't swim UNTIL she was four.'
    'until' = ... gacha.
    'but she was four' — mantiqsiz.
    'to she was four' — grammatik XATO.

 8  'They didn't have RUNNING water then.'
    ⚠ 'RUNNING WATER' = vodoprovod suvi
    (turg'un birikma).
    'flowing water' / 'moving water' —
       oqayotgan suv (daryo), boshqa ma'no.

 9  'I live on the south COAST of England.'
    ⚠ 'the south COAST' = janubiy SOhIL
    (mamlakat chegarasi).
    'beach' = plyaj (dam olish joyi).
    'seaside' = dengiz bo'yi (dam olish
       joyi sifatida).

10  'THE Amazon River is in South America.'
    ⚠ DARYOLAR oldida DOIM 'THE':
       the Amazon, the Nile, the Thames

    Boshqa 'the' bilan keladiganlar:
       okeanlar (the Atlantic)
       tog' tizmalari (the Alps)
       cho'llar (the Sahara)

    'THE' YO'Q:
       ko'llar (Lake Baikal)
       yakka tog'lar (Mount Everest)
       mamlakatlar (England)


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  a turning  = burilish
  education  = ta'lim
  Switzerland = Shveytsariya
  to complete = tugatmoq
  in those days = o'sha kunlarda
  in front of = oldida
  until      = ... gacha
  running water = vodoprovod suvi
  the coast  = sohil
  a beach    = plyaj
  the seaside = dengiz bo'yi

exercises.explanationUz:
BEShTA DIALOG — SAVOLNI TOPISh KERAK.

⚠ DIQQAT: 1, 2, 3, 4-bandlarda savolning
BIR QISMI allaqachon bosilgan — faqat
BOShINI to'ldirish kerak.


BARCHA JAVOBLAR:

 1  A: 'WHAT TIME DID YOU get up yesterday?'
    B: 'Seven o'clock in the morning.'

 2  A: 'WHERE DID YOU live when you were
        young?'
    B: 'I lived in Glasgow.'

 3  A: 'WHEN WAS THE LAST TIME you had a
        haircut?'
    B: 'I had a haircut a month ago.'

 4  A: 'WHY DID YOU LEAVE early?'
    B: 'I left early because I was very
        tired.'

 5  A: 'WHEN DID HE DIE?'
    B: 'He died on 3rd October, 1965.'


QANDAY TOPILADI:

 1  Bosilgan: '... get up yesterday?'
    Javob: 'SEVEN O'CLOCK in the morning.'
    → SOAT so'ralgan
    → 'What time did you ...?'

 2  Bosilgan: '... live when you were young?'
    Javob: 'I lived IN GLASGOW.'
    → JOY so'ralgan
    → 'Where did you ...?'

 3  Bosilgan: '... you had a haircut?'
    Javob: 'I had a haircut A MONTH AGO.'
    → VAQT so'ralgan
    → 'When was the last time ...?'

    ⚠ 1-mashqning 4-bandi AYNAN shu qurilma:
    'When was the LAST TIME you visited your
     parents?'

 4  Bosilgan: '... early?'
    Javob: 'I left early BECAUSE I was very
    tired.'
    → SABAB so'ralgan
    → 'Why did you leave early?'

 5  Javob: 'He died ON 3RD OCTOBER, 1965.'
    → SANA so'ralgan
    → 'When did he die?'


⚠ 5-BAND — ENG KO'P XATO QILINADIGAN:

  'When DID he DIE?'  ✓
  'When did he DIED?' ✗

  'did' dan keyin ASOSIY shakl!

  Javobda esa 2-shakl: 'He DIED.'

  ⚠ 1-mashqning 1-bandi bilan solishtiring:
     'He WAS BORN in 1938 and DIED in 1987.'


⚠ 4-BANDDA 'LEAVE':
  'Why did you LEAVE early?' (asosiy shakl)
  'I LEFT early.' (2-shakl)

  leave → LEFT → left


DIQQAT — 'HAVE A HAIRCUT':
  'to have a haircut' = soch oldirmoq

  'I HAD a haircut a month ago.'
  ⚠ 'a month AGO' — Past Simple bilan.


DIQQAT — SANA O'QILIShI:
  'on 3rd October, 1965'
  → 'on the third of October, nineteen
     sixty-five'


YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to get up   = turmoq (uyqudan)
  Glasgow     = Glazgo (Shotlandiya shahri)
  a haircut   = soch olish
  to have a haircut = soch oldirmoq
  to leave    = ketmoq
  tired       = charchagan
  to die      = vafot etmoq

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Did you see Lindsay yesterday? I didn't go to school yesterday.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kecha Lindsini ko'rdingizmi? Kecha maktabga bormadim.

sentencePatterns.formula: WHERE WAS/WERE + [ega] + BORN?  —  [ega] WAS BORN in [joy].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Where were you born? Charles Dickens was born in Portsmouth.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Qayerda tug'ilgansiz? Charlz Dikkens Portsmutda tug'ilgan.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'be born' — MAJHUL nisbat.
'Where DID you be born?' — XATO.

sentencePatterns.formula: [ega] COULDN'T + [ASOSIY fe'l] ..., but [ega] CAN + [ASOSIY fe'l] NOW.
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Emily couldn't read when she was two, but she can read now.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Emili ikki yoshida o'qiy olmasdi, lekin hozir o'qiy oladi.

sentencePatterns.formula: [A] is BETWEEN [B] AND [C].   /   [A] is ON THE CORNER OF [B] AND [C].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: The cinema is between the café and the post office. My house is on the corner of Pine Road and Maple Avenue.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kinoteatr kafe bilan pochta orasida. Uyim Payn va Meypl ko'chalari burchagida.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Ikkalasida ham 'AND' bor, lekin predlog
boshqa: BETWEEN (orasida) ↔ ON the corner
(burchagida).

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: They had two sons, but they didn't have any daughters.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Ularning ikki o'g'li bor edi, lekin qizi yo'q edi.

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: What time did you get up? Where did you live? Why did you leave? When did he die?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Soat nechchida turdingiz? Qayerda yashadingiz? Nega ketdingiz? U qachon vafot etdi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
⚠ 'did' dan keyin DOIM ASOSIY shakl
('did he died' XATO).

sentencePatterns.formula: [ega] WAS BORN in [yil] and DIED in [yil].
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He was born in 1938 and died in 1987.

sentencePatterns.formula: When was the LAST TIME you + [2-SHAKL] ... ?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: When was the last time you visited your parents / had a haircut?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Oxirgi marta qachon ota-onangizni ko'rgansiz / soch oldirgansiz?

sentencePatterns.exampleEn: He could talk when he was one, but he couldn't walk.
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: U bir yoshida gapira olardi, lekin yura olmasdi.
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'could' — 'can' ning o'tmish shakli.
Keyin ASOSIY shakl.

sentencePatterns.formula: Excuse me, CAN/COULD you tell me THE WAY TO + [joy]?
sentencePatterns.exampleEn: Excuse me, can you tell me the way to the bank?
sentencePatterns.exampleUz: Kechirasiz, bankka boradigan yo'lni ayta olasizmi?
sentencePatterns.explanationUz:
'Could you ...?' — muloyimroq.
Javob: 'Take the first turning on your left.'
